name: short-link-system
description: 基于 Cloudflare 的短链管理系统

scripts.build: npm run build:frontend && npm run build:worker
scripts.db:migrate: cd worker && npx wrangler d1 migrations apply short-link-db --local
scripts.db:migrate:remote: cd worker && npx wrangler d1 migrations apply short-link-db --remote --config wrangler.build.toml
scripts.check: cd worker && npx tsc --noEmit && cd ../frontend && npx tsc --noEmit
scripts.deploy:ci: npm run build:config && cd worker && npx wrangler deploy --config wrangler.build.toml
